game.title: Metro: Last Light Redux
game.blurb: Post-apocalyptic first-person shooter from 4A Games (RAWG also lists Deep Silver and Fishlabs Entertainment), released 2014-08-25. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones, hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Moments Along the Way
chapters.summary: Training, the Rhino, the Bear, the prisoners, the teddy bear, the Theater show, the Dead City visions, the Red Line and drinking at every chance.

chapters.title: Level Challenges
chapters.summary: Ghost, no-kill, no-hit and no-damage runs through the named levels, such as FACILITY, SEPARATION, REVOLUTION, ECHOES, ASHES and BRIDGE.

chapters.title: Diary Pages and Safes
chapters.summary: Artyom's 43 hidden diary pages and the locked safe boxes.

chapters.title: Combat, Stealth and Gear
chapters.summary: Kill counts, stealth kills, throwing knives, filters, lights, switches, traps, cobwebs, spiders and weapon choice.

chapters.title: Survival and Spartan Modes
chapters.summary: Finishing the game in Survival Mode and in Spartan Mode.

chapters.title: Added Levels
chapters.summary: The extra levels the achievements name: SNIPER TEAM, KSHATRIYA, HEAVY SQUAD, TOWER, SPIDER LAIR, DEVELOPER, PAVEL, KHAN and ANNA.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 287390)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Metro:_Last_Light
Fandom (metrovideogame.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://metrovideogame.fandom.com/wiki/Metro_Last_Light
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 287390 is the Redux itself: its schema is named "Project Redux Two" (an internal codename) and the store list confirms it as "Metro: Last Light Redux"; no app for the original 2013 release was found under that name in the store list. RAWG's first result is the expected Redux entry (id 3604); RAWG keeps the 2013 "Metro: Last Light" separately. StrategyWiki has nothing under "Metro: Last Light Redux"; "Metro: Last Light" is a stub (completion stage 0, marked as a stub) with Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents linked but not written. metro.fandom.com is an unrelated transit wiki; metrovideogame.fandom.com redirects "Metro: Last Light" to "Metro Last Light", with about 99 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. 6 of 49 Steam achievements are hidden and sit in the main story chapter. Nine achievements name extra levels (2% to 12%, all "Complete the ... level" except DEVELOPER); RAWG has a separate "Metro: Last Light - Tower Pack" entry that matches the TOWER level, but the packs holding the other levels are not named in the data, so they share one "Added Levels" chapter. The level order of the main campaign is not in the data, so level feats are grouped by type.
